name: Expert_RSI_Stochastic_MA
summary: This EA generates trading signals by combining RSI, Stochastic Oscillator, and Moving Average indicators. It enters buy positions when RSI is oversold, Stochastic is in the oversold zone, and price is above the MA, and enters sell positions under the opposite conditions. The strategy aims to capture momentum reversals confirmed by trend direction.
summary_zh: 该EA通过结合RSI、随机指标和移动平均线三个指标来生成交易信号。当RSI超卖、随机指标处于超卖区域且价格位于均线上方时买入，反之则卖出。策略旨在捕捉由趋势方向确认的动量反转机会。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多指标共振策略，核心概念是利用RSI判断超买超卖状态、随机指标确认动量反转、移动平均线确定趋势方向。入场条件为买入时RSI低于阈值且Stochastic金叉且价格在MA上方，卖出时RSI高于阈值且Stochastic死叉且价格在MA下方。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或指标反转信号。仓位管理方面，该类EA一般采用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面缺乏动态调整机制，未考虑账户整体风险敞口。该策略的弱点在于多指标信号可能相互矛盾，且在震荡行情中频繁发出错误信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-indicator confluence strategy where RSI identifies overbought/oversold levels, Stochastic confirms momentum reversals, and the Moving Average determines the prevailing trend direction. Entry conditions require all three indicators to align: a buy signal occurs when RSI is below its oversold threshold, Stochastic shows a bullish crossover, and price trades above the MA; sell signals follow the opposite logic. Exit conditions typically involve fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or indicator reversal signals. Position sizing generally relies on fixed lot sizes or a percentage-of-equity approach without dynamic adjustment. Money management lacks comprehensive risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or correlation-aware position sizing. The strategy's weakness lies in potential signal conflicts between indicators and frequent false signals during choppy, range-bound markets that can lead to consecutive losses.
pros: 多指标共振过滤减少了虚假信号，提高了入场质量
结合趋势判断和动量反转，逻辑较为合理
参数可调节性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间周期优化
同时使用趋势指标和震荡指标，在趋势行情中表现较好
pros_en: Multi-indicator confluence reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Combining trend direction with momentum reversal creates logically sound signals
Highly customizable parameters allow optimization across instruments and timeframes
Using both trend and oscillator indicators performs well in trending markets
cons: 多指标信号在震荡市中容易互相矛盾导致频繁交易亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理机制
未包含点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
固定止盈止损未考虑市场波动率变化
回撤控制不足，缺少最大回撤限制和整体风险敞口管理
cons_en: Multiple indicator signals can conflict in choppy markets causing frequent losing trades
Lacks dynamic position sizing and comprehensive money management
No spread filter or trading session filter may cause entries under unfavorable conditions
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit ignore market volatility changes
Insufficient drawdown control without maximum drawdown limits or portfolio risk management
improvements: 增加波动率自适应的止盈止损机制（如ATR止损）
加入点差过滤和交易时段限制以避免不利交易环境
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户风险和波动率调整手数
增加最大回撤限制和最大连续亏损次数保护机制
improvements_en: Add volatility-adaptive stop-loss/take-profit using ATR-based exits
Implement spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid unfavorable conditions
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account risk and market volatility
Add maximum drawdown limits and maximum consecutive loss protection mechanisms

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤可能导致高滑点成本下交易
固定止损未考虑波动率，在低波动时止损过宽在高波动时止损过窄
缺乏最大回撤保护和连续亏损控制机制
risk_points_en: No spread filter may cause trading under high spread conditions with excessive slippage costs
Fixed stop-loss ignores volatility — too wide in low volatility, too tight in high volatility
Lacks maximum drawdown protection and consecutive loss control mechanisms
